svg.title: 02 - Module architecture
svg.desc: Three entry points, one orchestrator, the v2 analysis stack, one immutable result document.
svg.text: Three entry points, one orchestrator, the v2 analysis stack, one immutable result document.
preflight (4 checks) - create run dir - orchestrate
results{} - metrics.http + metrics.resources + series + step_windows (assembled by engine.run())
server.py serves these artifacts from /runs/<id>/<file> (SAFE_ARTIFACTS whitelist); ui/app.js polls /api/status and /api/log at 1 Hz.
Sources: heavyload/runner.py, engine.py, samplers.py, procmetrics.py, comparison_sources/, quality.py, scalability.py, suitability.py, schema/, report.py, server.py
